from math import gcd

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==9 or v==7]
    # ARC objects use their marker color; background is the other dominant color.
    # Any two same-color markers define a straight segment; fill intermediate lattice cells.
    for i,(r1,c1) in enumerate(pts):
        for r2,c2 in pts[i+1:]:
            dr,dc=r2-r1,c2-c1
            g=gcd(abs(dr),abs(dc))
            if not g: continue
            sr,sc=dr//g,dc//g
            for k in range(1,g):
                r,c=r1+k*sr,c1+k*sc
                if out[r][c] not in (7,9): out[r][c]=3
    return out
